a261015p1.summary: A sell-off in global technology hardware stocks deepened Thursday, with Asian chipmakers tracking Wall Street losses as concerns …
a261015p1.title: Asian chipmakers extend Wall Street losses as US Fed rate hike fears and AI funding worries mount; SK Hynix fell 10%+ on the KRX, while Samsung fell ~10% (Lee Ying Shan/CNBC)

a261015p10.summary: This is an edited transcript of “The Ezra Klein Show.” You can listen to the episode wherever you get your podcasts.
a261015p10.title: Q&A with MIT sociologist Sherry Turkle, who has been studying relationships between humans and machines since the 1970s, on her new book, AI chatbots, and more (New York Times)

a261015p11.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. said Thursday it will build another 3-nanometer chip factory in the Taiwanese city of Tainan …
a261015p11.title: TSMC says it plans to build an additional 3nm fab in Tainan, Taiwan, set for production in H1 2028, alongside its 3nm capacity in Arizona and Japan's Kumamoto (Qianer Liu/The Information)

a261015p12.summary: The OpenAI employee who was arrested and charged with allegedly using a hidden recording device in one of the ChatGPT maker's …
a261015p12.title: Filing: Abdulrahman Alfozan, his wife, and a family member booked one-way tickets from the US to Saudi Arabia for October 12; the FBI arrested him on October 9 (Rachel Metz/Bloomberg)

a261015p13.summary: The employee, now fired, had said he advised government agencies in Saudi Arabia. He was also listed as a partner at a venture firm with a Saudi prince.
a261015p13.title: Abdulrahman Alfozan, who worked at Meta and gained US residency in 2020, advised Saudi organizations and is listed as a venture partner at Riyadh-based RAED (Emmy Martin/New York Times)

a261015p14.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. is in discussions about collaborating with Elon Musk's Terafab project …
a261015p14.title: TSMC CEO C.C. Wei says the company is in talks over Elon Musk's Texas-based Terafab project, but stresses that any participating fab "has got to be run by TSMC" (Debby Wu/Bloomberg)

a261015p15.summary: Nearly 4 in 10 U.S. adults - including about half of those 18 to 29 - are part of an online community
a261015p15.title: Survey: nearly 40% of US adults, and ~50% of those aged 18 to 29, participate in an online community; social media is the primary venue for online communities (Pew Research Center)

a261015p16.summary: Earlier this week, a mass hack of refrigeration systems at an estimated 700 supermarkets throughout France caused them to suddenly malfunction …
a261015p16.title: A hack of Internet-connected fridge controllers across ~700 European supermarkets exploited critical vulnerabilities in three models flagged by Claroty and CISA (Dan Goodin/Ars Technica)

a261015p17.summary: Researchers at The Citizen Lab have for the first time released technical evidence of sophisticated mercenary spyware being distributed via online advertising.
a261015p17.title: Citizen Lab details AdFection, a zero-click spyware campaign where an Israeli ad company routed targets to spyware servers and infected dozens of devices (Wired)

a261015p18.summary: Ramp has surged to $2 billion in annualized revenue, the fintech company plans to announce Thursday — a milestone that's helped attract fresh investor capital.
a261015p18.title: Ramp raised $1.85B led by Dragoneer at a $60B valuation, up from $44B after raising $750M in June, and hits $2B in annualized revenue, up from $1.5B in June (Rebecca Torrence/Bloomberg)

a261015p19.summary: AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI have long mentioned the possibility that their products could be existentially dangerous …
a261015p19.title: AI industry extinction warnings are genuine rather than corporate plots for regulatory capture or hype, and they go as far back as the mid-2000s and the 2010s (Scott Alexander/Astral Codex Ten)

a261015p2.summary: Dutch semiconductor equipment giant ASML expects China to account for about 20 per cent of its total sales this year …
a261015p2.title: ASML expects China to account for ~20% of total sales this year, after Q3 sales there surged 109% QoQ, lifting China's share of machine sales from 14% to 23% (Xiaofei Xu/South China Morning Post)

a261015p20.summary: The FTC sought documents from Anthropic and OpenAI with the scope of the probe focused on potential consumer protection violations, a person familiar told Axios.
a261015p20.title: Source: the US FTC issues ~50-page civil investigative demands to OpenAI and Anthropic over safety incidents, safeguarding practices, and consumer protection (Maria Curi/Axios)

a261015p21.summary: Money from Tether flowed to Nxum while Bo Hines worked in the White House on landmark stablecoin legislation.
a261015p21.title: Sources and docs: while Bo Hines helped craft the crypto-friendly Genius Act, he had a 33% stake in consulting firm Nxum, which received millions from Tether (Sam Kessler/Wall Street Journal)

a261015p3.summary: Allowing users to add their own information to the company's generative AI-based ASKB interface will feed the system with a new level of context
a261015p3.title: Bloomberg is making its ASKB conversational AI interface available to all Terminal users, letting them integrate their own content with existing financial data (Steven Rosenbush/Wall Street Journal)

a261015p7.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. on Thursday reported a record third-quarter profit that beat estimates, powered by an unrelenting global appetite for AI chips.
a261015p7.title: TSMC reports Q3 revenue up 50.9% YoY to $46.36B, net income up 68.7% to $23.7B, both above est., marking a sixth straight quarterly profit record on AI demand (Jenny Lee/CNBC)

a261015p8.summary: Design platform Figma announced a new Markdown-based editor to help define a company's design, bring in design and code libraries …
a261015p8.title: Figma announces new features to define how AI agents work on its platform, including Figma Specs, a Markdown editor that lets users define their design language (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)

a261015p9.summary: New software from L-Acoustics helps isolate a singer's voice to cut through concert noise
a261015p9.title: A look at L-Acoustics, whose audio platform uses machine learning to help artists like Céline Dion isolate their voices and cut through noise at live concerts (Benoit Berthelot/Bloomberg)
